Title: ELSA-2026-99208:  perl-DBI security update (IMPORTANT)
Description:
[1.643-12.3]
- CVE-2026-88815 perl-DBI: perl-DBI: Denial of Service via invalid memory read during numeric type casting
  Resolves: RHEL-285727

[1.643-12.2]
- CVE-2026-78030 perl-DBI: DBI versions before 1.653 for Perl load arbitrary modules via unvalidated dbm_type and dbm_mldbm attributes in DBD::DBM
  Resolves: RHEL-282730

[1.643-12.1]
- CVE-2026-73194 perl-DBI: DBI for Perl: Heap out-of-bounds write via unvalidated numeric placeholder
  Resolves: RHEL-247328

[1.643-12]
- Fix resource exhaustion via excessive '?' placeholders in preparse
  (CVE-2026-14739)
  Resolves: RHEL-193299
- Fix heap overflow in SQL preparsing can lead to denial of service
  or arbitrary code execution. (CVE-2026-10879)
  Resolves: RHEL-193981

[1.643-11]
- Fix arbitrary code execution via crafted profile package names
  (CVE-2026-14380)
  Related: RHEL-211150

[1.643-10]
- Fix stack overflow and buffer overflow in DBI.xs (CVE-2026-9698)
  Related: RHEL-184983

Criterions.Comment: perl-DBI is signed with the Oracle Linux 9 key
perl-DBI is signed with the Oracle Linux 9 key
